# pkc/lexer

> pkc: the tokenizer (port of internal/lang/lexer.go).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/lexer.pkg)

`lx_lex(src, file, puncts, holes)` returns a `Vec` of `ptr Tok`, or `null`
with `pk_err` set. Like the Go lexer it works on Unicode code points:
columns count code points, and invalid UTF-8 bytes become U+FFFD.
String and character literals are unquoted with Go's rules.

Letters and spaces outside ASCII follow a close approximation of Go's
`unicode.IsLetter` and `unicode.IsSpace`; identifiers in real programs
are ASCII.

```
const TK_EOF = 0
const TK_NL = 1
const TK_IDENT = 2
const TK_INT = 3
const TK_STR = 4
const TK_PUNCT = 5
const TK_HOLE = 6
const TK_CHAR = 7

struct Tok
  kind: int
  text: str
  ival: int
  file: str
  line: int
  col: int
end

fn lx_tok(v: ptr Vec, i: int) -> ptr Tok
  return vec_get(v, i) as ptr Tok
end

fn lx_pos(t: ptr Tok) -> str
  return u_cat4(t.file, ":", str_from_int(t.line), u_cat(":", str_from_int(t.col)))
end

// lx_describe renders a token for error messages, like Token.String.
fn lx_describe(t: ptr Tok) -> str
  if t.kind == TK_EOF
    return "end of file"
  elif t.kind == TK_NL
    return "end of line"
  elif t.kind == TK_STR
    return u_quote(t.text)
  elif t.kind == TK_CHAR
    return lx_quote_rune(t.ival)
  elif t.kind == TK_HOLE
    return u_cat3("{", t.text, "}")
  end
  return u_cat3("'", t.text, "'")
end

fn lx_quote_rune(r: int) -> str
  if r == 39
    return "'\\''"
  elif r == 92
    return "'\\\\'"
  elif r == 10
    return "'\\n'"
  elif r == 9
    return "'\\t'"
  elif r == 13
    return "'\\r'"
  elif r == 0
    return "'\\x00'"
  elif r < 32 || r == 127
    let b = sb_new()
    sb_add(b, "'\\x")
    u_hex(b, r)
    sb_byte(b, '\'')
    return sb_str(b)
  end
  return u_cat3("'", lx_encode_one(r), "'")
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- UTF-8

// lx_decode turns s into code points; invalid bytes become U+FFFD.
fn lx_decode(s: str) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let i = 0
  let n = len(s)
  while i < n
    let c = s[i] as int
    let r = 65533
    let size = 1
    if c < 128
      r = c
    elif c >= 194 && c <= 223 && i + 1 < n && lx_cont(s[i + 1])
      r = ((c & 31) << 6) | ((s[i + 1] as int) & 63)
      size = 2
    elif c >= 224 && c <= 239 && i + 2 < n && lx_cont(s[i + 1]) && lx_cont(s[i + 2])
      let v = ((c & 15) << 12) | (((s[i + 1] as int) & 63) << 6) | ((s[i + 2] as int) & 63)
      if v >= 2048 && (v < 55296 || v > 57343)
        r = v
        size = 3
      end
    elif c >= 240 && c <= 244 && i + 3 < n && lx_cont(s[i + 1]) && lx_cont(s[i + 2]) && lx_cont(s[i + 3])
      let v = ((c & 7) << 18) | (((s[i + 1] as int) & 63) << 12) | (((s[i + 2] as int) & 63) << 6) | ((s[i + 3] as int) & 63)
      if v >= 65536 && v <= 1114111
        r = v
        size = 4
      end
    end
    vec_push(out, r)
    i = i + size
  end
  return out
end

fn lx_cont(c: u8) -> bool
  return ((c as int) & 192) == 128
end

fn lx_encode_into(b: ptr StrBuf, r: int)
  if r < 128
    sb_byte(b, r as u8)
  elif r < 2048
    sb_byte(b, (192 | (r >> 6)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | (r & 63)) as u8)
  elif r < 65536
    sb_byte(b, (224 | (r >> 12)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | ((r >> 6) & 63)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | (r & 63)) as u8)
  else
    sb_byte(b, (240 | (r >> 18)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | ((r >> 12) & 63)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | ((r >> 6) & 63)) as u8)
    sb_byte(b, (128 | (r & 63)) as u8)
  end
end

fn lx_encode_one(r: int) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  lx_encode_into(b, r)
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn lx_encode(rs: ptr Vec, from: int, stop: int) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = from to stop - 1
    lx_encode_into(b, vec_get(rs, i))
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- classes

fn lx_space(r: int) -> bool
  if r == 32 || r >= 9 && r <= 13 || r == 133 || r == 160
    return true
  end
  return r == 5760 || r >= 8192 && r <= 8202 || r == 8232 || r == 8233 || r == 8239 || r == 8287 || r == 12288
end

fn lx_letter(r: int) -> bool
  if r < 128
    return r >= 97 && r <= 122 || r >= 65 && r <= 90
  end
  if r < 192
    return r == 170 || r == 181 || r == 186
  end
  if r == 215 || r == 247 || r == 65533 || lx_space(r)
    return false
  end
  // punctuation, symbols, arrows, box drawing, dingbats, emoji
  if r >= 8192 && r <= 11263 || r >= 11776 && r <= 11903 || r >= 12288 && r <= 12351 || r >= 65024 && r <= 65103 || r >= 126976
    return false
  end
  return true
end

fn lx_digit(r: int) -> bool
  return r >= 48 && r <= 57
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- unquoting

fn lx_hexval(r: int) -> int
  if r >= 48 && r <= 57
    return r - 48
  elif r >= 97 && r <= 102
    return r - 87
  elif r >= 65 && r <= 70
    return r - 55
  end
  return -1
end

// lx_unquote follows Go's strconv.Unquote for "..." and '...'. For a
// character literal, *rune is set to the character's value.
fn lx_unquote(rs: ptr Vec, from: int, stop: int, ok: ptr bool, rune_: ptr int) -> str
  *ok = false
  let quote = vec_get(rs, from)
  let b = sb_new()
  let i = from + 1
  let count = 0
  let last = 0
  while i < stop - 1
    let c = vec_get(rs, i)
    if c == quote && quote == 34
      return ""
    end
    if c == 10
      return ""
    end
    if c != 92
      lx_encode_into(b, c)
      last = c
      count = count + 1
      i = i + 1
      continue
    end
    if i + 1 >= stop - 1
      return ""
    end
    let e = vec_get(rs, i + 1)
    i = i + 2
    let v = -1
    let raw_byte = false
    if e == 97
      v = 7
    elif e == 98
      v = 8
    elif e == 102
      v = 12
    elif e == 110
      v = 10
    elif e == 114
      v = 13
    elif e == 116
      v = 9
    elif e == 118
      v = 11
    elif e == 92
      v = 92
    elif e == 39 || e == 34
      if e != quote
        return ""
      end
      v = e
    elif e == 120 || e == 117 || e == 85
      let digits = 2
      if e == 117
        digits = 4
      elif e == 85
        digits = 8
      end
      if i + digits > stop - 1
        return ""
      end
      v = 0
      for k = 0 to digits - 1
        let h = lx_hexval(vec_get(rs, i + k))
        if h < 0
          return ""
        end
        v = v * 16 + h
      end
      i = i + digits
      if e == 120
        raw_byte = true
      elif v > 1114111 || v >= 55296 && v <= 57343
        return ""
      end
    elif e >= 48 && e <= 55
      if i + 2 > stop - 1
        return ""
      end
      v = e - 48
      for k = 0 to 1
        let d = vec_get(rs, i + k)
        if d < 48 || d > 55
          return ""
        end
        v = v * 8 + d - 48
      end
      i = i + 2
      if v > 255
        return ""
      end
      raw_byte = true
    else
      return ""
    end
    if raw_byte && quote == 34
      sb_byte(b, v as u8)
    else
      lx_encode_into(b, v)
    end
    last = v
    count = count + 1
  end
  if quote == 39
    if count != 1
      return ""
    end
    *rune_ = last
  end
  *ok = true
  return sb_str(b)
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- lexing

fn lx_new(kind: int, text: str, file: str, line: int, col: int) -> ptr Tok
  let t = new Tok
  t.kind = kind
  t.text = text
  t.file = file
  t.line = line
  t.col = col
  return t
end

fn lx_err(file: str, line: int, col: int, msg: str) -> ptr Vec
  pk_err = u_cat4(file, ":", str_from_int(line), u_cat4(":", str_from_int(col), ": ", msg))
  return null
end

// lx_emit appends a token; newlines are dropped inside parentheses, at the
// start and after another newline.
fn lx_emit(toks: ptr Vec, t: ptr Tok, depth: int)
  if t.kind == TK_NL && (depth > 0 || vec_len(toks) == 0 || lx_tok(toks, vec_len(toks) - 1).kind == TK_NL)
    return
  end
  vec_push(toks, t as int)
end

fn lx_starts(rs: ptr Vec, i: int, op: ptr Vec) -> bool
  if i + vec_len(op) > vec_len(rs)
    return false
  end
  for k = 0 to vec_len(op) - 1
    if vec_get(rs, i + k) != vec_get(op, k)
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

fn lx_lex(src: str, file: str, puncts: ptr Vec, holes: bool) -> ptr Vec
  // ( ) , and the type syntax : [ ] are core; the rest come from packages.
  // Longer operators are tried first.
  let all = vec_new()
  u_push(all, "(")
  u_push(all, ")")
  u_push(all, ",")
  u_push(all, ":")
  u_push(all, "[")
  u_push(all, "]")
  for i = 0 to vec_len(puncts) - 1
    u_push(all, u_get(puncts, i))
  end
  let ops = vec_new()
  let opr = vec_new()
  let longest = 0
  for i = 0 to vec_len(all) - 1
    if len(u_get(all, i)) > longest
      longest = len(u_get(all, i))
    end
  end
  let size = longest
  while size > 0
    for i = 0 to vec_len(all) - 1
      let o = u_get(all, i)
      if len(o) == size
        u_push(ops, o)
        vec_push(opr, lx_decode(o) as int)
      end
    end
    size = size - 1
  end

  let toks = vec_new()
  let rs = lx_decode(src)
  let n = vec_len(rs)
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let depth = 0
  let i = 0
  while i < n
    let r = vec_get(rs, i)
    let pl = line
    let pc = col
    let adv = 0
    if r == 10
      lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_NL, "", file, pl, pc), depth)
      adv = 1
    elif lx_space(r)
      adv = 1
    elif r == 47 && i + 1 < n && vec_get(rs, i + 1) == 47
      let j = i
      while j < n && vec_get(rs, j) != 10
        j = j + 1
      end
      adv = j - i
    elif holes && r == 123
      let j = i + 1
      while j < n && vec_get(rs, j) != 125
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j >= n
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, "unterminated {hole}")
      end
      lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_HOLE, u_trim(lx_encode(rs, i + 1, j)), file, pl, pc), depth)
      adv = j + 1 - i
    elif lx_letter(r) || r == 95
      let j = i
      while j < n && (lx_letter(vec_get(rs, j)) || lx_digit(vec_get(rs, j)) || vec_get(rs, j) == 95)
        j = j + 1
      end
      lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_IDENT, lx_encode(rs, i, j), file, pl, pc), depth)
      adv = j - i
    elif lx_digit(r)
      let j = i
      while j < n && (lx_digit(vec_get(rs, j)) || vec_get(rs, j) == 95)
        j = j + 1
      end
      let text = u_replace(lx_encode(rs, i, j), "_", "")
      let ok = false
      let v = str_parse_int(text, &ok)
      if !ok
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, u_cat3("number ", text, " does not fit in 64 bits"))
      end
      let t = lx_new(TK_INT, text, file, pl, pc)
      t.ival = v
      lx_emit(toks, t, depth)
      adv = j - i
    elif r == 39
      let j = i + 1
      while j < n && vec_get(rs, j) != 39 && vec_get(rs, j) != 10
        if vec_get(rs, j) == 92
          j = j + 1
        end
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j >= n || vec_get(rs, j) != 39
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, "unterminated character literal")
      end
      let ok = false
      let v = 0
      lx_unquote(rs, i, j + 1, &ok, &v)
      if !ok || v > 255
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, "a character literal must be one byte, e.g. 'a' or '\\n'")
      end
      let t = lx_new(TK_CHAR, str_from_int(v), file, pl, pc)
      t.ival = v
      lx_emit(toks, t, depth)
      adv = j + 1 - i
    elif r == 34
      let j = i + 1
      while j < n && vec_get(rs, j) != 34 && vec_get(rs, j) != 10
        if vec_get(rs, j) == 92
          j = j + 1
        end
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j >= n || vec_get(rs, j) != 34
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, "unterminated string")
      end
      let ok = false
      let unused = 0
      let s = lx_unquote(rs, i, j + 1, &ok, &unused)
      if !ok
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, "bad string literal: invalid syntax")
      end
      lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_STR, s, file, pl, pc), depth)
      adv = j + 1 - i
    else
      let op = -1
      for k = 0 to vec_len(ops) - 1
        if lx_starts(rs, i, vec_get(opr, k) as ptr Vec)
          op = k
          break
        end
      end
      if op < 0
        return lx_err(file, pl, pc, u_cat3("unknown symbol ", lx_quote_rune(r), " (no loaded package defines it)"))
      end
      let text = u_get(ops, op)
      if text == "("
        depth = depth + 1
      elif text == ")" && depth > 0
        depth = depth - 1
      end
      lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_PUNCT, text, file, pl, pc), depth)
      adv = vec_len(vec_get(opr, op) as ptr Vec)
    end
    for k = 1 to adv
      if vec_get(rs, i) == 10
        line = line + 1
        col = 1
      else
        col = col + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  lx_emit(toks, lx_new(TK_NL, "", file, line, col), depth)
  vec_push(toks, lx_new(TK_EOF, "", file, line, col) as int)
  return toks
end

fn lx_dump(toks: ptr Vec) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(toks) - 1
    let t = lx_tok(toks, i)
    sb_int(b, t.line)
    sb_byte(b, ':')
    sb_int(b, t.col)
    let names = make([str], 8)
    names[0] = "eof"
    names[1] = "newline"
    names[2] = "ident"
    names[3] = "int"
    names[4] = "str"
    names[5] = "punct"
    names[6] = "hole"
    names[7] = "char"
    sb_byte(b, ' ')
    sb_add(b, names[t.kind])
    if t.kind == TK_IDENT || t.kind == TK_PUNCT || t.kind == TK_INT || t.kind == TK_CHAR
      sb_byte(b, ' ')
      sb_add(b, t.text)
    elif t.kind == TK_STR
      sb_byte(b, ' ')
      sb_add(b, pf_dquote(t.text))
    end
    sb_byte(b, '\n')
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
